primaryChecks.text: Have the gods of the nations delivered them, which my fathers have destroyed—Gozan, Haran, Rezeph, and the children of Eden who were in Telassar?
primaryChecks.previousContext: Behold, you have heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands, by destroying them utterly. Will you be delivered?
primaryChecks.nextContext: Where is the king of Hamath, the king of Arpad, and the king of the city of Sepharvaim, of Hena, and Ivvah?’”
